# gsap-nuxt-module

Nuxt 3/4 module for typed, build-time GSAP plugin registration and scoped
animation lifecycle management.

Documentation: https://lucaargentieri.github.io/gsap-nuxt-module/
Repository: https://github.com/LucaArgentieri/gsap-nuxt-module
GSAP docs: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/

## Install

```bash
bun add gsap-nuxt-module
```

```ts
export default defineNuxtConfig({
  modules: ['gsap-nuxt-module'],
  gsap: { plugins: ['ScrollTrigger'] },
})
```

## Preferred usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const root = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null)

useGsap(() => {
  gsap.from('.item', { opacity: 0, y: 24 })
}, { scope: root })
</script>
```

Use `useGsap(setup)` for automatic cleanup and page-transition-aware teardown.
Redirected, cancelled, and rapid consecutive navigations are lifecycle-safe.
Use zero-argument `useGsap()` only when cleanup is managed manually.

Plugin composables are named `use<Plugin>()` and require the matching entry in
`gsap.plugins`. Dependencies are automatic: ScrollSmoother adds ScrollTrigger;
CustomWiggle and CustomBounce add CustomEase.

Full agent reference: /gsap-nuxt-module/llms-full.txt
